rabbit.summary: The model is a recognizable chibi rabbit, but it stands on four long legs like a dog. The mockup rabbit sits upright on its haunches with its front paws together.
strengths: The tall ears with pink inner color match the mockup.
The gray body, light feet, and white pom tail follow the mockup palette.
The identity reads in all 8 sprite directions.
issues: The pose is different. Change the rest pose to a seated rabbit on its haunches with the front paws together.
The legs are too long and the body is dog-like. Make the legs short and the hind legs large and folded.
The face is different. The eyes are too large and stare, and the eyelashes are missing. Make the eyes smaller, add lashes, and use a small curved smile.
The head is pure white. The mockup head is a warm cream color. Change the head color to cream.
The walk clip is a dog trot. Use a hop for the move clip. The rabbit also has a howl clip, which does not fit a rabbit.
rabbit.next: Rebuild the rest pose as a seated rabbit with short folded hind legs, as in the mockup.

hare.summary: The model is a stocky brown rabbit with black ear tips. The mockup is a slim, orange, long-legged animal with wide flared ears, so the body plan is wrong.
strengths: The black ear tips are present.
The cream chest and the orange-ringed eyes follow the mockup.
The model stands on the ground with a rig and a walk clip.
issues: The body plan is wrong. Make the body slim and the legs long and thin, as in the mockup.
The ears are vertical rabbit ears. Make them wide and flared out to the sides, with large dark tips.
The color is a dull tan-brown. Change it to the saturated orange of the mockup and make the feet black.
The white pom tail is not in the mockup. Replace it with a small dark tail.
The model is a recolor of the rabbit. The hare does not have its own silhouette.
hare.next: Rebuild the body with a slim torso and long thin legs with black feet.

squirrel.summary: The model is an orange squirrel with ear tufts and a tall tail, but it stands stiffly on four long legs like a dog. The mockup squirrel leaps with a large round curled tail.
strengths: The rust-orange color and the cream chest follow the mockup.
The ear tufts are present.
The bushy tail makes the identity clear at 128 px.
issues: The pose and body are different. Make the body slim with large hind legs, and tuck the front paws at the chest.
The tail is a narrow, lumpy column. Make it a wide, round curl over the back, as in the mockup.
The tail surface has noisy lumps that look like a sponge. Use soft fur grooves with a smaller displacement.
The face is different. Replace the wide line mouth and the dotted muzzle with a small smile, and give the eyes brown irises.
The legs are too long and straight. Shorten them.
squirrel.next: Rebuild the tail as a wide round curl with soft fur, and give the body a squirrel crouch with large hind legs.

bat.summary: The model is a lumpy brown fur ball with wide spread wings and thin legs. The mockup is an upright chibi bat with a large head, a small body, a cream face mask, and low wings.
strengths: The large ears with a tan inner color are present.
The fly clip has a readable wing flap.
The wings have a clear membrane shape.
issues: The body plan is wrong. Separate a large head from a small upright body that sits on two feet.
The face is different. Add the cream face mask, larger eyes with highlights, a dark nose, and a clear smile.
The fur has noisy lumps that look like a coconut shell. Use a smooth clay surface.
The wings spread high and wide. Make them smaller and hold them low at the sides of the body.
The thin bird legs are not in the mockup. Use short round feet. Add the cream belly.
bat.next: Rebuild the body as a large head on a small upright body with a cream face mask and belly.

bee.summary: The head is a good match for the mockup, but the body stands horizontal on six long stilt legs. The mockup bee hovers upright with short dangling legs.
strengths: The fuzzy yellow head, the glossy black eyes, and the smile match the mockup.
The antennae with ball tips match the mockup.
The striped abdomen reads as a bee at 128 px.
issues: The pose is different. Put the body upright under the head in a hover pose.
The six stilt legs are too long and look like a spider. Make the legs short and let them hang.
The thorax color is different. The mockup thorax is black fuzz with one yellow band.
The fly clip stays on the ground. The legs stay planted and the wings barely move. Lift the bee off the ground and make a fast wing flap.
The model shares its body with the wasp. The two insects look almost the same from the front.
bee.next: Change the rest pose to an upright hover above the ground with short dangling legs.

wasp.summary: The model is the bee body with a smooth surface and a pointed abdomen. It stands horizontal on six stilt legs, but the mockup wasp hovers upright with curled antennae.
strengths: The yellow and black stripes and the stinger are present.
The narrow waist shows in the side view.
The wings are clear and see-through.
issues: The pose is different. Put the body upright under the head in a hover pose with bent legs.
The wasp looks almost the same as the bee from the front. Give it its own head shape and a slimmer body.
The antennae are elbowed. Make them long and curled, as in the mockup.
The head is too large for the body. Make the head smaller and the abdomen longer.
The fly clip stays on the ground with planted legs. Lift the wasp off the ground and make a fast wing flap.
wasp.next: Change the rest pose to an upright hover with a slim body and curled antennae.

butterfly.summary: The head and the wings are a close match for the mockup. The body stands horizontal on six stilt legs with a long abdomen, but the mockup butterfly hovers upright with a small round body.
strengths: The cream face, the black cap, the blush cheeks, and the smile match the mockup.
The orange wings with black edges and white dots match the mockup palette.
The face and the wing color read in the sprites.
issues: The pose is different. Replace the long horizontal abdomen and the stilt legs with a small round body under the head.
The antenna tips are forked hooks. Make them round spiral curls.
The wings are too small and too vertical. Make them larger and spread them to the sides.
The fly clip stays on the ground. Lift the butterfly off the ground and make a large wing flap.
The small arms of the mockup are missing. Add them at the front of the body.
butterfly.next: Rebuild the body as a small round upright body that hovers, with the wings spread to the sides.

moth.summary: The model is a brown insect with a closed smile, feathered antennae, and six stilt legs. The mockup is an upright fluffy moth with a large cream mane around the face and an open happy mouth.
strengths: The brown and beige palette follows the mockup.
The wings have round spots.
The model stands on the ground with a rig and clips.
issues: The cream fur mane around the face is missing. Add a large fluffy mane that frames the face.
The pose is different. Put a round upright body under the head with small arms, and remove the stilt legs.
The expression is different. Change the closed smile to an open happy mouth.
The antennae are long feathered leaves. Make them short with round dark knobs, as in the mockup.
The fly clip stays on the ground with planted legs. Lift the moth off the ground and flap the wings.
moth.next: Add the large cream mane around the face and change the body to an upright hover.
